title: FACTDOUBLE: a seven-row spot check, all seven matching
status_plain: Seven rows were compared and all seven matched. Seven rows is a spot check, not a sweep. FACTDOUBLE sits inside a catalogue row whose header lists it among open discrepancies while its own clause reports full agreement -- a scope trap for anyone reading the row header as the status of every member. FACTDOUBLE is also a member of the XMD-008 FINITE family, which carries no count.

counts.build_note: No build appears on this catalogue clause.
counts.ambiguity_note: Seven rows. The source states neither how they were chosen nor whether any were held out.

evidence_locality_note: The W109 G4-04 sweep corpora are gitignored in OxFunc.
reader_warning: Seven of seven is a spot check on a seven-row corpus. It is not a sweep and it carries no held-out component. FACTDOUBLE also appears as an uncounted member of the XMD-008 error-surface family.
